description: This C# source file provides extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface to add grain call filters (incoming and outgoing) to the Orleans silo's service pipeline. It includes methods to add filters directly, by implementation type, or via delegates.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to add grain call filters (incoming and outgoing).

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter instance to the silo builder pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds a filter implementation specified by type TImplementation to the pipeline.

methods.name: AddIncomingGrainCallFilter (delegate version)
methods.description: Adds an IIncomingGrainCallFilter via a delegate.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter instance to the silo builder pipeline.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter<TImplementation>
methods.description: Adds a filter implementation specified by type TImplementation for outgoing calls.

methods.name: AddOutgoingGrainCallFilter (delegate version)
methods.description: Adds an IOutgoingGrainCallFilter via a delegate.
